_about: Each circle's grammar line for the circle overview, with the target language between ** for bold (Dan, 2026-11-16; src/lib/note-text.js). Unit id to text; import.mjs puts it in place of the workbook's plain grammar_point. Keep the wording in step with the workbook's.

points.U01: **ser** for who you are: **eu sou**, **você é**; **um** and **uma**; **não**
points.U03: Set phrases; **obrigado** from a man, **obrigada** from a woman; **estar** for how you are: **Como você está?** **Estou bem**; **Como vai?** **Tudo bem?**
points.U04: Verbs in the present: **como**, **come**; **bebo**, **bebe**; **gostar de** for liking: **gosto de café**
points.U05: **ter** in the present: **eu tenho**, **você tem**, **ele tem**
points.U32: **Como se diz…?** **O que significa…?** **O que quer dizer…?**
points.U06: Plurals: **os** and **as**; nouns add **-s** (and **-m** becomes **-ns**); **nós somos**, **vocês são**, **eles são**; **temos** and **têm**
points.U07: Adjectives agree with the noun (**novo**, **nova**; **bonito**, **bonita**) and usually follow it; **muito** and **também**
points.U52: **Gosto de** + a verb (**gosto de nadar**); **canto**, **canta**: **-ar** verbs; **leio**, **lê**: **ler** is irregular
points.U08: **estar** for where something is: **está**, **estão**, **estamos**; **em** + **o** = **no**, **em** + **a** = **na**; **tem** for there is
points.U09: **estar** with an adjective that agrees: **estou cansado**, **estou cansada**; **estar com** for hunger, thirst and cold: **estou com fome**
points.U33: **Estou procurando a palavra…**; **é uma coisa para…**; **não sei**
points.U10: Possessives agree with the thing owned: **meu**, **minha**, **meus**, **minhas**; **seu**, **sua**; **dele** and **dela** for his and her
points.U11: Question words come first: **quem**, **o que**, **onde**, **quando**, **por que**, **qual**; **porque** in the answer
points.U53: **Onde fica…?** asks where a place is; **no hotel**, **na praia**: **em** + **o**, **em** + **a**; **perto** and **longe**
points.U12: Numbers one to ten; **dois** and **duas** agree; **quantos** and **quantas** with a plural noun
points.U13: Colours come after the noun; most agree (**vermelho**, **vermelha**), **azul** and **verde** do not change in the singular
points.U14: Time words: **hoje**, **amanhã**, **agora**; days of the week without a capital; **Que horas são?**
points.U15: **ir** in the present: **eu vou**, **você vai**, **nós vamos**; **para** for where you are going; **ao** and **à**
points.U51: **Ela tem olhos azuis**, **ele tem cabelo curto**: **ter** for features; **alto**, **alta**: adjectives agree; **estou com dor de cabeça**
